+//! One newline-delimited JSON request per local connection; workers never open SQLite.
+use crate::{Controller, runtime::Runtime};
+use serde_json::json;
+use std::{
+    fs,
+    io::{Read, Write},
+    os::unix::{
+        fs::{FileTypeExt, PermissionsExt},
+        net::{UnixListener, UnixStream},
+    },
+    path::Path,
+    time::{Duration, Instant},
+};
+const MAX_REQUEST: usize = 1_048_576;
+const REQUEST_DEADLINE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1);
+
+/// Serve until process shutdown. A stale socket may be removed only after proving no listener.
+/// Keep the socket and database directory outside worker mounts.
+pub fn serve(controller: Controller, socket: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Result<(), String> {
+    serve_with_runtime(controller, socket, None)
+}
+pub fn serve_with_runtime(
+    controller: Controller,
+    socket: impl AsRef<Path>,
+    runtime: Option<Runtime>,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let socket = socket.as_ref();
+    if let Ok(metadata) = fs::symlink_metadata(socket) {
+        if !metadata.file_type().is_socket() {
+            return Err("socket path exists and is not a socket".into());
+        }
+        match UnixStream::connect(socket) {
+            Ok(_) => return Err("socket already has a live listener".into()),
+            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::ConnectionRefused => {
+                fs::remove_file(socket).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
+            }
+            Err(e) => return Err(format!("cannot establish stale socket: {e}")),
+        }
+    }
+    let listener = UnixListener::bind(socket).map_err(|e| format!("socket bind: {e}"))?;
+    fs::set_permissions(socket, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+    listener.set_nonblocking(true).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+    let mut next_reconcile = Instant::now();
+    let autonomous = {
+        let enabled = runtime.is_some();
+        #[cfg(feature = "fault-injection")]
+        let enabled =
+            enabled && std::env::var("CORENIUS_TEST_MANUAL_RUNTIME").as_deref() != Ok("1");
+        enabled
+    };
+    loop {
+        if autonomous && false && Instant::now() >= next_reconcile {
+            if let Err(error) = runtime.as_ref().unwrap().drain(&controller) {
+                eprintln!("runtime drain: {error}");
+            }
+            next_reconcile = Instant::now() + Duration::from_millis(250);
+        }
+        let stream = match listener.accept() {
+            Ok((stream, _)) => stream,
+            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
+                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(10));
+                continue;
+            }
+            Err(error) => return Err(format!("socket accept: {error}")),
+        };
+        if let Err(e) = serve_request(&controller, runtime.as_ref(), stream) {
+            eprintln!("connection: {e}");
+        }
+    }
+}
+fn serve_request(
+    controller: &Controller,
+    runtime: Option<&Runtime>,
+    mut stream: UnixStream,
+) -> Result<(), String> {
+    let deadline = Instant::now() + REQUEST_DEADLINE;
+    let response = match read_request(&mut stream, deadline) {
+        Ok(None) => return Ok(()),
+        Err(error) => json!({"error":error}),
+        Ok(Some(bytes)) => match serde_json::from_slice(&bytes) {
+            Ok(request) => match route(controller, runtime, request) {
+                Ok(value) => json!({"ok":value}),
+                Err(error) => json!({"error":error}),
+            },
+            Err(_) => json!({"error":"invalid JSON"}),
+        },
+    };
+    let bytes = format!("{response}\n").into_bytes();
+    let mut offset = 0;
+    while offset < bytes.len() {
+        stream
+            .set_write_timeout(Some(remaining(deadline)?))
+            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+        let n = stream.write(&bytes[offset..]).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+        if n == 0 {
+            return Err("response transport closed".into());
+        }
+        offset += n;
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}
+fn route(
+    controller: &Controller,
+    runtime: Option<&Runtime>,
+    request: serde_json::Value,
+) -> Result<serde_json::Value, String> {
+    if request.get("runtime").is_some() {
+        let fields = request.as_object().ok_or("invalid runtime request")?;
+        if fields.len() != 3 || request["runtime"] != json!({"kind":"reconcile"}) {
+            return Err("runtime accepts only authenticated project reconciliation".into());
+        }
+        return runtime
+            .ok_or("runtime not configured")?
+            .reconcile(controller, &request);
+    }
+    let kind = request["command"]["kind"].as_str();
+    if kind == Some("transition_operation")
+        || (kind == Some("observe_attempt")
+            && (runtime.is_some() || request["command"]["args"]["state"] == "exited"))
+    {
+        return Err("lifecycle observations require controller-owned runtime evidence".into());
+    }
+    controller.handle(request)
+}
+fn remaining(deadline: Instant) -> Result<Duration, String> {
+    deadline
+        .checked_duration_since(Instant::now())
+        .filter(|d| !d.is_zero())
+        .ok_or_else(|| "whole request deadline exceeded".into())
+}
+pub(crate) fn read_request(
+    stream: &mut UnixStream,
+    deadline: Instant,
+) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>, String> {
+    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
+    let mut buffer = [0u8; 8192];
+    loop {
+        stream
+            .set_read_timeout(Some(remaining(deadline)?))
+            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+        let n = stream
+            .read(&mut buffer)
+            .map_err(|e| format!("request read deadline or transport error: {e}"))?;
+        if n == 0 {
+            return if bytes.is_empty() {
+                Ok(None)
+            } else {
+                Err("request framing limit".into())
+            };
+        }
+        if let Some(end) = buffer[..n].iter().position(|b| *b == b'\n') {
+            bytes.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..=end]);
+            if bytes.len() > MAX_REQUEST {
+                return Err("request size limit".into());
+            }
+            return Ok(Some(bytes));
+        }
+        bytes.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..n]);
+        if bytes.len() > MAX_REQUEST {
+            return Err("request size limit".into());
+        }
+    }
+}

+    pub workspace: PathBuf,
+    pub home: PathBuf,
+    pub scratch: PathBuf,

+pub trait WorkspacePreparer {
+    fn prepare(&self, root: &Path, binding: &Binding) -> Result<Workspace>;

+pub struct EmptyWorkspace;

+    fn prepare(&self, root: &Path, binding: &Binding) -> Result<Workspace> {

+pub fn prepare_workspace(root: &Path, attempt: &str) -> Result<Workspace> {
+    valid_id(attempt)?;
+    canonical_directory(root)?;
+    let attempt_root = root.join(attempt);
+    fs::create_dir(&attempt_root).map_err(|e| format!("new attempt root: {e}"))?;
+    private_directory(&attempt_root)?;
+    let paths = Workspace {
+        workspace: attempt_root.join("workspace"),
+        home: attempt_root.join("home"),
+        scratch: attempt_root.join("scratch"),
+    };
+    for path in [&paths.workspace, &paths.home, &paths.scratch] {
+        fs::create_dir(path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+        private_directory(path)?;
+    }

+fn valid_id(value: &str) -> Result<()> {

+fn canonical_directory(path: &Path) -> Result<()> {

+            .is_symlink()

+    }
+    Ok(())

+fn private_directory(path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
+    canonical_directory(path)?;
+    fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())

+        .read(true)
+        .write(true)
+        .create(true)
+        .mode(0o600)
+        .custom_flags(libc::O_NOFOLLOW)
+        .open(path)

+}
+fn persist(root: &Path, execution: &Execution) -> Result<()> {
+    let temporary = root.join(format!(".{}.tmp", execution.binding.operation));
+    let mut file = private_file(&temporary)?;

+        root.join(format!("{}.json", execution.binding.operation)),

+fn start_ticks(pid: u32) -> Result<String> {
+    let stat = fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{pid}/stat")).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+    let (_, tail) = stat
+        .rsplit_once(") ")
+        .ok_or("invalid kernel process identity")?;
+    tail.split_whitespace()
+        .nth(19)
+        .map(str::to_owned)
+        .ok_or("missing process start identity".into())
+}
+fn init_terminated(pid: u32, expected_ticks: &str) -> Result<bool> {
+    let stat = match fs::read_to_string(format!("/proc/{pid}/stat")) {
+        Ok(stat) => stat,
+        Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(true),
+        Err(error) => return Err(format!("namespace termination inaccessible: {error}")),
+    };
+    let (_, tail) = stat
+        .rsplit_once(") ")
+        .ok_or("invalid init kernel identity")?;
+    let fields: Vec<_> = tail.split_whitespace().collect();
+    let ticks = fields.get(19).ok_or("missing init start time")?;
+    // Zombie state is reached after Linux has destroyed PID1's namespace descendants.
+    Ok(*ticks != expected_ticks || fields.first() == Some(&"Z"))
+}

+    fn observe(&mut self, operation: &str) -> Result<()> {

+/// Bounded private local transport. Neither socket nor its secret is mounted into attempts.
+pub fn call(
+    socket: &Path,
+    token: &str,
+    action: &str,
+    binding: &Binding,
+) -> Result<Option<Execution>> {
+    let mut stream =
+        UnixStream::connect(socket).map_err(|e| format!("supervisor unavailable: {e}"))?;
+    stream
+        .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(1)))
+        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+    stream
+        .set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(1)))
+        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+    writeln!(
+        stream,
+        "{}",
+        json!({"token":token,"action":action,"binding":binding})
+    )
+    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+    let response = read_line(stream)?;
+    if let Some(error) = response.get("error") {
+        return Err(format!("supervisor: {error}"));
+    }
+    let execution: Option<Execution> = serde_json::from_value(
+        response
+            .get("ok")
+            .ok_or("missing supervisor reply")?
+            .clone(),
+    )
+    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+    if let Some(e) = &execution {
+        if &e.binding != binding
+            || Uuid::parse_str(&e.handle).is_err()
+            || Uuid::parse_str(&e.incarnation).is_err()
+            || Uuid::parse_str(&e.boot_id).is_err()
+            || !matches!(e.state.as_str(), "running" | "unknown" | "exited")
+        {
+            return Err("supervisor identity validation refused".into());
+        }
+        if e.state == "running"
+            && (e.pid.is_none()
+                || e.start_ticks
+                    .as_ref()
+                    .is_none_or(|s| s.parse::<u64>().is_err()))
+        {
+            return Err("supervisor kernel identity missing".into());
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(execution)
+}
+fn read_line(mut stream: UnixStream) -> Result<Value> {
+    let bytes = crate::service::read_request(&mut stream, Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(1))?
+        .ok_or("empty supervisor request")?;
+    serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
+}
+pub fn serve(config: impl AsRef<Path>, socket: impl AsRef<Path>, token: &str) -> Result<()> {
+    serve_with_workspace(config, socket, token, &EmptyWorkspace)
+}
+pub fn serve_with_workspace(
+    config: impl AsRef<Path>,
+    socket: impl AsRef<Path>,
+    token: &str,
+    preparer: &dyn WorkspacePreparer,
+) -> Result<()> {
+    if token.len() < 12 {
+        return Err("supervisor secret must have at least 12 bytes".into());
+    }
+    let mut supervisor = Supervisor::open(config.as_ref())?;
+    let socket = socket.as_ref();
+    if !socket.is_absolute() || socket.starts_with("/usr") {
+        return Err("private supervisor socket outside toolchain mount required".into());
+    }
+    if let Ok(metadata) = fs::symlink_metadata(socket) {
+        if !metadata.file_type().is_socket() {
+            return Err("supervisor socket alias/non-socket refused".into());
+        }
+        match UnixStream::connect(socket) {
+            Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::ConnectionRefused => {
+                fs::remove_file(socket).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
+            }
+            _ => return Err("supervisor socket already owned or ambiguous".into()),
+        }
+    }
+    let listener = UnixListener::bind(socket).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+    fs::set_permissions(socket, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+    for stream in listener.incoming() {
+        let mut stream = stream.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+        stream
+            .set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(1)))
+            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+        stream
+            .set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(1)))
+            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
+        let response = read_line(stream.try_clone().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?)
+            .and_then(|value| serde_json::from_value::<Request>(value).map_err(|e| e.to_string()))
+            .and_then(|request| {
+                if request.token != token {
+                    Err("supervisor authentication failed".into())
+                } else {
+                    supervisor.handle(request, preparer)
+                }
+            });
+        let response = match response {
+            Ok(value) => json!({"ok":value}),
+            Err(error) => json!({"error":error}),
+        };
+        let _ = writeln!(stream, "{response}"); // A lost reply leaves the same durable operation identity.
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}
